meta.name: Karimi Gordunuz Mu
meta.description: Hakkı is a famous and quite wealthy businessman. Despite having many tourist facilities and a yacht, Hakkı never refuses his wife Makbule’s desire to go on vacation to different places. He arranges a beautiful hotel reservation for their desired holiday. From the moment they enter the hotel, all eyes are on the flashy couple. Hakkı, who tries to criticize those around him, eventually realizes that his wife is no longer by his side. He starts searching for his wife around the hotel but can’t find her…
